name: Sylvan-Firth

civilization.name: The Ossuarine Choirs
civilization.notes: Long dead; only ruins and orbital debris remain of a civilization that flourished before the world turned hostile.

description: Whatever this world was, it finished. Gray plains run to a dead horizon, interrupted by glass plains from an ancient cataclysm and the glassed scars of some ancient catastrophe.
No wind, no voice, no weather: the landscape communicates in light and shadow alone, and it has plenty to say at sunrise.
Surveyors date the monolithic structures of unknown origin to before the region's last cataclysm, which should be impossible. The structures are unweathered, as if time skipped this place.
Archaeologists and weapons engineers circle the same sites, quoting each other's permits with disgust. The ruins tolerate both, so far.
